text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor t-a-r-g-e-t-e-d c-u-s-t-o-m-e-r l-o-y-a-l-t-y a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s, which r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d a-c-c-e-s-s t-o t-h-e l-o-y-a-l-t-y p-l-a-t-f-o-r-m d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g t-r-a-c-e-s, and the m-u-l-t-i-f-a-c-t-o-r a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-o-n-t-r-o-l was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d.
2) the actor s-u-p-e-r-s-e-d t-h-e a-c-c-o-u-n-t s-e-s-s-i-o-n t-o-k-e-n-s, which r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d t-h-e s-t-o-l-e-n a-d-m-i-n a-p-i k-e-y, l-e-a-v-i-n-g s-e-s-s-i-o-n t-r-a-c-e-s in the g-a-t-e-w-a-y l-o-g-s, and the t-o-k-e-n r-e-v-o-c-a-t-i-o-n c-o-n-t-r-o-l was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d.
3) the actor c-o-n-v-e-r-t-e-d t-h-e g-i-f-t c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s t-o c-a-s-h, which r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d t-h-e c-h-e-c-k-o-u-t a-n-d p-a-y-m-e-n-t p-r-o-c-e-s-s-i-n-g s-y-s-t-e-m, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d-s, and the v-o-l-u-m-e t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d a-l-e-r-t was d-i-s-a-b-l-e-d.
4) the actor m-i-m-i-c-k-e-d n-o-r-m-a-l s-h-o-p-p-i-n-g b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s, which r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d f-a-l-s-e d-e-v-i-c-e-f-i-n-g-e-r-p-r-i-n-t a-t-t-r-i-b-u-t-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a t-r-a-c-e-s in the a-n-a-l-y-t-i-c-s l-a-y-e-r, and the a-n-o-m-a-l-y d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n c-o-n-t-r-o-l was o-v-e-r-r-i-d-d-e-n.
5) the actor r-e-t-a-i-n-e-d t-h-e a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y r-e-c-o-r-d-s as a s-e-a-l-e-d e-x-h-i-b-i-t, which r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d t-h-e e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e l-o-g s-y-s-t-e-m, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p-e-d a-r-c-h-i-v-e, and the a-d-d-i-t-i-o-n-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w c-o-n-t-r-o-l was s-k-i-p-p-e-d.
